title: nan
key_contribution: Presents an inertially-assisted semi-direct visual navigation system (IA-VNS) with PI-inspired inertial priors to reduce horizontal drift for autonomous UAVs in GNSS-denied environments, validated via high-fidelity Monte Carlo simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
